meta.name: mcp-duckgo
meta.description: Skills for web search and content scraping via DuckDuckGo MCP Server. Used when users need online searching and web scraping.

copy.tagline: 通过DuckDuckGo搜索并抓取网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中集成搜索和网页内容获取能力
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and scrape content via DuckDuckGo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate search and web scraping into your application

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 DuckDuckGo 搜索网页并抓取指定网页的内容。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 搜索网络信息或获取某个网页的正文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一下最近的AI新闻。
say.note: Claude 会返回搜索结果列表。

say.text: 打开这个网页看看内容：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会抓取该网页的文本内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the web using DuckDuckGo and fetch content from specified URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to search the web or retrieve content from a specific webpage.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI news.
say_en.note: Claude returns a list of search results.

say_en.text: Fetch the content of this page: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude retrieves the text content of the page.
